summary: This table presents a financial performance summary comparing key metrics for the years ending December 31, 2024, and December 31, 2023. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, among other financial indicators. Notably, revenues increased from 13,997 in 2023 to 14,547 in 2024, reflecting a growth of 3.9%. Operating profit also saw an increase, rising to 3,080 in 2024 from 2,917 in 2023, with a growth rate of 5.6%. The net profit before minority interest rose to 2,348 in 2024, up from 2,209 in 2023, marking a growth of 6.3%. Additionally, the diluted EPS increased from 0.53 to 0.57, indicating a positive trend in earnings per share. The table highlights the overall financial growth and performance improvements year-over-year.
